public_payload.normalized_proposition: If big tech removes AI from their companies, it will be embarrassing, damaging to their stocks, and an admission it was a waste.

statement.excerpt: Yet this situation is so much bigger and uglier because they have put so much money and so thoroughly welded AI to their companies that removing it will be both embarrassing and damaging to their stocks, and a tacit admission that all of this was a waste.

from_speaker: a tacit admission that all of this was a waste
our_interpretation: The antecedent is a substantial company-wide withdrawal from generative AI by a firm discussed in the passage, rather than cancellation of one product or infrastructure project.
Stock damage means an adverse market reaction attributable to that withdrawal, assessed against market movements and other simultaneous announcements.
Embarrassment and a tacit admission require public reputational evidence or company explanations; they cannot be inferred from a falling share price alone.
criteria.support_condition: A qualifying withdrawal occurs and credible evidence establishes the predicted stock damage and reputational consequences.
criteria.contradiction_condition: A qualifying withdrawal occurs and sufficiently clear evidence shows the predicted consequences did not occur, or that the market rewarded the withdrawal.
